candidateEngineV2Diagnostic.rules: Pre-specified from stage evidence diagnostics; requires separate-period robustness before any Live use.

spec.eligibility: Attractive Growth stage + Higher highs + higher lows structure
spec.philosophy: Preserve structurally healthy growth names; RS, momentum, volume and room-to-resistance rank candidates instead of acting as hard exclusion gates.
spec.freezeRule: Historical baseline only. The later cohort audit challenged the HH/HL eligibility gate; do not treat this version as the active forward candidate.

attractiveGrowthDiscoveryV1.note: Buckets validate prioritization only; they are not return forecasts or exclusion thresholds.

spec.eligibility: Stage classification only; no RS, momentum, volume, or room-to-resistance hard gate.

rankingOnly.structure: HH/HL strongest; Structure improving supportive; Lower highs + lower lows penalty
rankingOnly.relativeStrength: RS20 >=4 strongest, >=0 supportive, negative values reduce priority but do not exclude
rankingOnly.momentum: positive/improving momentum raises priority; sharp deterioration lowers priority but does not exclude
rankingOnly.volume: up/down volume >=1.2 raises priority; weak volume lowers priority but does not exclude
rankingOnly.roomToResistance: >=7 strongest, >=3 usable; <3 lowers priority but does not exclude

spec.researchFinding: Across four independent batches, single hard gates were unstable. HH/HL + volume showed promise in some batches but failed in others; HH/HL + RS was also inconsistent. Preserve breadth and use the evidence as ranking until forward data is accumulated.
spec.freezeRule: Do not promote a historical winner into an exclusion rule. Any threshold/gate change requires a new version and forward cohort.

hhhlGateAudit.note: Accepted/rejected is a retrospective audit of the HH/HL gate, not a recommendation to hard-filter future candidates.

attractiveGrowthCohortAuditV1.note: Audit whether the stage cohort itself is useful before tuning ranking. No Live/core behavior is changed.

spec.purpose: Test whether setup location explains why the strongest raw momentum/RS bucket can underperform the middle bucket.
spec.rule: Diagnostic only. No dimension is an eligibility gate.

attractiveGrowthEntryContextV1.note: Diagnostic only; use to understand entry location, not to create hard filters.

spec.purpose: Test whether Attractive Growth ranking failures are explained by extension from MA20/MA50 and recent-high location before changing ranking.
spec.rule: No extension band is an eligibility gate. Diagnostic only.

spec.purpose: Test whether MA20 extension is harmful mainly when combined with already-hot RS, momentum, volume, breakout, or raw room. Do not create a hard gate from a historical subgroup.

attractiveGrowthHeatExtensionInteraction.note: Compare extended versus not-extended inside the same heat/context subgroup, then verify whether the interaction is actually concentrated in V2 Top. Diagnostic only; ranking unchanged.

spec.philosophy: Rank chart-worthy Attractive Growth names without hard HH/HL, RS, momentum, volume or room gates. Reward healthy structure and constructive pullback; reduce the old bias toward maximum heat and excessive raw room.
spec.freezeRule: Research candidate only; do not replace frozen V1 or Live/core from historical results.

attractiveGrowthRankV2Candidate.note: Historical comparison only. Broad discovery is preserved; score changes priority only.

spec.philosophy: Preserve V2 broad discovery and ranking, but apply one small anti-extension penalty when price is >=6% above MA20. No hard gate and no MA50 penalty.
spec.evidence: Across all four batches the old Top bucket was more concentrated in dist20 >=6 and that band had worse downside, but a standalone one-point MA20 penalty did not improve ranking robustness.
spec.finding: Rejected after four-batch 5/10/20D comparison: at 20D average Top/Middle mean return shifted from about 1.40/1.29 in V2 to 1.27/1.36 in V3. Extension alone is not the ranking fix.
spec.freezeRule: Rejected research candidate. Keep only as a historical comparison; do not promote to Live/core.

attractiveGrowthRankV3Candidate.note: Historical comparison only. V3 differs from V2 only by a one-point dist20 >=6 extension penalty.

spec.philosophy: Preserve V2 broad discovery and all existing evidence weights. Apply one small ranking-only penalty only when momentumShift >= 6 and price is >=6% above MA20.
spec.evidence: Across four batches at 20D, the extended momentum>=6 subgroup had lower mean and excess return plus worse MAE and hit-7 in all 4/4 batches. The same interaction was also more concentrated in V2 Top than Middle in all 4/4 batches.
spec.finding: Rejected as a ranking fix. Four-batch averages showed only modest Top downside improvement while Top/Middle return separation narrowed: 20D V2 1.40/1.29 vs V4 1.38/1.36; 10D V2 0.75/0.62 vs V4 0.72/0.69.
spec.freezeRule: Rejected research candidate. Keep only as historical evidence; do not promote to Live/core.

attractiveGrowthRankV4Candidate.note: Historical comparison only. V4 differs from V2 only by a one-point penalty for the pre-identified momentum>=6 + dist20>=6 interaction.

spec.purpose: Measure whether coarse integer scores and cutoff ties make Top/Middle membership unstable, and inspect which cohorts V4 actually swaps at the Top boundary.

attractiveGrowthRankBoundaryDiagnosticV1.note: If a cutoff is tied, the current stable score sort inherits the existing deduped event order (date/symbol) within that score. Membership inside a large cutoff tie is therefore not further evidence-ranked.

spec.note: Frozen before independent historical validation. Do not tune rules or threshold from validation outcomes; any change requires V2.

spec.purpose: Check whether frozen Failed Breakdown / Reclaim results depend on stale historical breaks. No eligibility or ranking change.

earlyWatchReclaimAgeAuditV1.note: Age is sessions since the most recent close below the current confirmed local-low pivot; 0 means an intraday break/reclaim on the signal session.

spec.purpose: Check frozen Early Watch eligibility across chronological train/test and calendar years without retuning.

earlyWatchChronologicalAuditV1.note: No threshold is selected from these results; this is a stability audit only.

spec.purpose: Re-test Early Watch evidence after filtering for the condition before dedupe, so an earlier non-matching Early Watch day cannot censor a later trigger.

earlyWatchConditionFirstAuditV1.note: Diagnostic only. No feature or interaction becomes an eligibility gate from this report.
